Bitcoin losses are the heaviest since FTX.

item.description:

That drop was forced by policy; this one is price-driven, with hash price at an all-time low.

item.title: The short term holder cost basis cluster has now turned into resistance. $BTC pu
item.description:
The short term holder cost basis cluster has now turned into resistance.

$BTC pushed up into this block today and was rejected.

These buyers are back near break-even, where many tend to sell.

A close above $65K would show that demand can absorb their selling.

@glassnode

The short-term holder cluster under bitcoin:native has failed to hold.

As price broke below the $62K–$65K block, short-term holders started ramping up their selling at a loss.

Cost basis clusters like this often become resistance once price is below them.
